chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: Do not take out anything from the meat of the hady.

key_terms.الْهَدْيِ: The sacrificial offering presented during hajj
key_terms.لَا تُخْرِجَنَّ: Do not take out; an emphatic prohibition

ai.seo_question: Can the meat of the hady be taken out of Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling from Imām Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام prohibiting the removal of any portion of the meat of the hady. In the context of the chapter, it indicates the disapprovedness or prohibition of taking sacrificial meat out from Minā during the rites of hajj.
